1.explanation:
We need to introduce (and export) a new DataTableGroup component so that consumers can simply import DataTableGroup instead of wiring up Select + DataTable manually. 

• src/js/components/index.js: this is the central barrel file for all top-level exports. It must be updated to export DataTableGroup.  

• src/js/components/Data/index.js: under the Data namespace we expose all Data-related pieces (DataForm, DataSummary, etc.); this file needs to import and re-export the new DataTableGroup so that it appears on the Data namespace (e.g. Data.DataTableGroup).
1.bug_scenario: The screenshots show that in the top bar of a DataTable-backed view there is a “Group by…” dropdown (with a list of available grouping keys such as Date, Severity, Details, etc.). In our library, there is no DataTableGroup component to render that control and wire it up to the DataTable’s groupBy prop. When someone tries to add “Group by” support they must hand-roll the Select and manage state themselves. We need a built-in DataTableGroup component that encapsulates that pattern.
